entities.name: Darigaaz
entities.description: One of the Primeval Dragons, the red Primeval, reincarnated several times; champion of the dragons of Shiv in his latest incarnation.

entities.name: Rith
entities.description: The green Primeval dragon, Darigaaz's sister, freed from the Magnigoth Treefolk in Yavimaya, who leads the freeing of the other Primevals.

entities.name: Treva
entities.description: The white Primeval dragon, freed from the catacombs beneath New Argive.

entities.name: Dromar
entities.description: The blue Primeval dragon, kept in a treasure cave beneath the ocean by his own desires.

entities.name: Crosis
entities.description: The black Primeval dragon, imprisoned in a tar pit in Urborg.

entities.name: Rokun
entities.description: A black dragon lord who tried to start a rebellion against Darigaaz and was slain by him.

entities.name: Tevesh Szat
entities.description: A draconic planeswalker who told Darigaaz of the legend of the Primeval Dragons.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A figure aboard the Weatherlight who touched Darigaaz's mind and brought him to his senses.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A figure who sought help from the people of Shiv against the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Tarox
entities.description: A dragon of the Bladewing brood who secretly hopes to seize control from Darigaaz.

entities.name: Palladia-Mors
entities.description: Darigaaz's mother, according to this page.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A skyship the newly reborn Primevals attacked as a challenge to their dominance of the skies.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A region of Dominaria home to dragons, viashino, Ghitu and goblins, where Darigaaz was imprisoned and later became champion.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: The forest where the green Primeval was held inside the Magnigoth Treefolk.

entities.name: New Argive
entities.description: A city taken by Phyrexians, in whose library catacombs the white Primeval was held.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: A region where the black Primeval Crosis was imprisoned in a tar pit.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the Primeval Dragons ruled before the age of men.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The invaders of Dominaria who destroyed the original red Primeval's remains.

entities.name: Dragon Nations
entities.description: The dragons of Dominaria, whose head Darigaaz became at the time of the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Coalition
entities.description: The alliance defending Dominaria against Phyrexian invasion, which Darigaaz's dragons joined.

entities.name: Primeval Dragons
entities.description: Five ancient, god-like dragons that ruled Dominaria before the age of men.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: A battle of the second Phyrexian invasion in which Darigaaz fought.

events.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz the legend of the Primeval Dragons and shows him the destroyed red Primeval's corpse in Shiv, saying the others can be awakened to aid the war.
events.quote: He showed Darigaaz the corpse of the red Primeval in Shiv

events.summary: Darigaaz slays the rebellious dragon lord Rokun and throws his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree, which frees Rith.
events.quote: Darigaaz slew the upstart, throwing his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree.

events.summary: Rith takes charge of the dragons and Darigaaz falls into line behind her.
events.quote: Darigaaz, awestruck, fell into line behind her leadership.

events.summary: At New Argive, Rith lets four dragon lords incinerate themselves with mana, and Treva is reborn; Darigaaz forbids further mortal sacrifices.
events.quote: the sacrifice worked and Treva was reborn.

events.summary: The Primevals break into Dromar's treasure cave beneath the ocean and Rith destroys part of the hoard to awaken him.
events.quote: To awaken him, Rith destroyed part of the hoard.

events.summary: In Urborg Rith reveals that the other four Primevals must sacrifice themselves, and that Darigaaz is himself the red Primeval; they throw themselves into Crosis' tar pit, freeing him.
events.quote: Darigaaz and the other Primevals threw themselves into Crosis' tar pit prison, freeing him.

events.summary: Reborn as a god, Darigaaz and the other Primevals chase the Weatherlight through the clouds.
events.quote: They set upon the vessel, furiously chasing it through the clouds.

events.summary: Karn touches Darigaaz's mind and he comes to his senses; horrified, Darigaaz throws himself into a volcano, breaking the pantheon and weakening the other Primevals so they can be slain.
events.quote: chose to throw himself into a volcano

events.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, a new Darigaaz hatches from an egg, lives among the Ghitu, and becomes champion of the dragons of Shiv.
events.quote: This Darigaaz hatched from an egg found in a temporal rift

events.summary: After a winged Phyrexian attacks the Weatherlight, Darigaaz and the dragons join the New Coalition and fight in the Battle of the Mana Rig.
events.quote: He was present and fought in the Battle of the Mana Rig

relations.quote: He was the son of Palladia-Mors and brother of Rith
Darigaaz slew the upstart, throwing his corpse onto the Magnigoth Tree.

relations.note: Szat guided him toward freeing the Primevals
relations.quote: Szat then told Darigaaz that the green Primeval was held in Yavimaya
Darigaaz and his dragon brethren agreed to join the New Coalition defending Dominaria
They slew the Phyrexians that had taken the city
